column1: # Absorption inventory (slice 0 of the spec absorption, 2026-10-30): every statement about the Concrete
# language found outside docs/spec, with where it goes. It is a plan, not a rule: the statements are
# paraphrases, the verdicts are a first reading by read-only inventory passes over the repository at
# wip/spec-s7 (c4af505b), with paths mapped to main cc876322, and each row is re-checked by the slice that
# absorbs it. A slice that absorbs, cites or deletes a file removes its rows (one_spec.py, S13).
# One `*` row per file gives the file's verdict; the other rows are statements.
# Columns: file, location, statement, kind (rule | guarantee | definition | grammar | semantics | builtin),
# spec_status (dup:<ID> | new | conflict:<ID> | stale[:<ID>] | open:<ID> | - for a verdict row), target chapter,
# action (cite | absorb | open | rationale | none | keep | cite-only | design-record | absorb-delete), notes.
